card.name: Words about plans, time and the future
card.fires_on: Nouns and verbs about time, plans or the future (long time, no current plan, projected into the future, planning, an idea to) in general web prose. It also fires inside the word assimilation in data-assimilation text.

modes.label: Plans and future
modes.description: Words for plans, ideas or the future in news and essay text.
modes.example: there’s no current<< plan>> to land people on the Moon itself.

modes.label: Duration or closeness
modes.description: Words completing phrases like for a long time or not far off.
modes.example: I have dreamt of performing a study like this for a long<< time>>,

modes.label: Data assimilation
modes.description: Inside the word assimilation in meteorology citations and text.
modes.example: Ensemble data assim<<ilation>> without perturbed observations.
